ambient_events: From the slag bar's spine the wastes stretch grey and featureless to every horizon.
A figure walks the far end of the slag bar, silhouetted, and is gone behind the ridge.
description: A long bar of fused slag thrown up like a levee across the deep wastes, high enough to climb and walk, a road for those who know it. From its spine you can see the whole grey sweep of the frontier, which is not a comfort.
name: Slag Bar
